title: A notification can be marked read or unread and shows its attachments
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). The Notifications page opens from the bell icon at the top right, next to your location name.
  2. Open the Notifications page from the bell icon at the top right (it opens on the Inbox tab).
  3. Seed a notification whose note carries an attachment: a second user writes the notes (on a QA branch the second user is the Tech quick-login user (sign in from a private browser window with the Tech button; appears as "Tech ShopView")): open a work order (top menu Work Orders -> click a work order number (e.g. S2-4219) -> Notes tab) -> New Note, type a message, type @ and pick "Admin ShopView" (or click a tag group pill you belong to under "Tag groups:"), then click Save; then, as that author, open the note's menu ( ... ) -> Add attachment and attach any file.
custom_steps:
1. Toggle a single notification between read and unread.
  2. Read a notification whose note has attachments.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • You can toggle a single notification between read and unread.
  • When a notification has attachments, they are shown on the notification.

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10245 (S2, Read a notification); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S2; design board InboxAfter; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R11: “The user can toggle a single notification between read and unread.”
  • S2-R12: “When a notification has attachments, they are shown on the notification.”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
